content: Drizzle ORM has no native concept of per-app-scoped migrations within a shared folder; monorepo community patterns recommend either (a) a dedicated shared data package with its own drizzle config/schema/migrations consumed by all apps, or (b) each service owning its own Drizzle instance with its own migrations history/journal. Sharing one migrations folder across services that should have divergent seed data is a known anti-pattern that community discussions flag as causing drift; no built-in Drizzle mechanism filters which seed SQL runs per consuming app.
